catalog.title: Product catalog
catalog.subtitle: Manage products, attributes by type, translations and prices.
catalog.categoriesDescription: Manage the store's main categories and subcategories.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.noSubcategories: This category has no active subcategories.
catalog.selectTypeFirst: Select a product type to see its attributes.
catalog.noAttributes: This type has no configured attributes.
catalog.attributeInvalid: The value of attribute “{{name}}” is not valid for its data type.
catalog.nameRequired: Enter the product name in at least one language.
catalog.priceHistoryHelp: Registered prices are not edited; to change a price, add a new validity period.
catalog.priceInvalid: Each price needs a currency, start date and a valid decimal amount (up to 4 decimals).
catalog.deactivateMessage: Product {{code}} will be deactivated and can no longer be sold. It is not deleted.

inventory.title: Inventory management
inventory.subtitle: Stock, purchase receipts, exits, approved adjustments and history.
inventory.warehousesDescription: Manage warehouses and the country they belong to.
inventory.exchangeRateHelp: Rate to the base currency; use 1 if the order is in the base currency.
inventory.invalidReceivedQuantity: The received quantity for “{{product}}” must be a whole number between 0 and the pending amount.
inventory.receiveAtLeastOne: Receive at least one unit on some line.
inventory.exitsDescription: Record losses, damage, theft or defects with the report number sent to the official supplier.

adjustmentActions.revalidar: Adjustment revalidated against current stock; it is pending approval again.

purchases.title: Supplier purchases
purchases.subtitle: Create purchase orders with each supplier's official products, send them and track their receipt.
purchases.noSupplierAccess: Your role cannot view suppliers; ask for the permission to create orders.
purchases.exchangeRateHelp: How many {{currency}} units 1 unit of the supplier's currency is worth (up to 8 decimals).
purchases.baseCurrencyRate: The supplier buys in {{currency}}, the base currency: the rate is 1.
purchases.newOrderHelp: The order is created as a draft in the supplier's purchase currency. Only its official products can be ordered.
purchases.noLinkedProducts: This supplier has no official products. Link them in the "Products by supplier" tab.
purchases.duplicateProduct: The product on line {{line}} is already on another line; set its quantity on a single line.
purchases.invalidCost: The unit cost on line {{line}} must be a number greater than or equal to zero, with up to 4 decimals.
purchases.draftHelp: The order is a draft: review it and send it to the supplier. Only sent orders can be received.
purchases.receiveHelp: Goods for this order are received in Inventory → Purchase receipts.
purchases.cancelWarning: The order will be cancelled and cannot be received. Only allowed while it has no receipts.
purchases.supplierProductsHelp: A supplier's official products are the only ones that can be ordered from it or reported in an inventory exit.
purchases.linkSuccess: "{{product}}" is now an official product of the supplier.
purchases.inactiveSupplier: The supplier is inactive: products cannot be linked and orders cannot be created.
purchases.emptyLinkedProducts: This supplier has no official products yet.

validation.dateRange: The start date cannot be after the end date.

validation.nonNegativeInteger: {{field}} must be a whole number of zero or more.
validation.positiveDecimal: {{field}} must be a decimal number greater than zero (use a decimal point or comma).

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: Record sales in the country's currency, confirm payment and issue the simulated receipt.
sales.noCountries: There are no countries enabled for sales within your scope.
sales.currencyHelp: Local currency of the sale's country.
sales.clientOptional: Optional. Search by name, surname or email (min. 2 letters).
sales.clientSearchHelp: Type to search customers of the country.
sales.lineIncomplete: Each product needs a warehouse in the sale's country.
sales.pendingHelp: The sale is created pending payment: current price, tax and exchange rate are calculated, and stock is not deducted until payment is confirmed.
sales.paymentMethodFreeText: This country has no configured payment methods; enter the one used.
sales.confirmedSuccess: Payment confirmed: stock was deducted and the sale is confirmed.
sales.cancelMessage: Only sales pending payment can be cancelled. Stock is not changed.
sales.simulatedReceipt: Simulated receipt: this is not an invoice or a tax document.

reports.title: Inventory reports

reports.saleFiltersHelp: Country and currency filters apply to sale movements.
